title: Moving clock: a ring clock carried by a body in the record background

key_results.statement: Decoupled body: $q(a;\lambda)=\lvert\langle a\vert e^{-iD'\lambda}\vert\eta\rangle\rvert^2$ exactly for all $\lambda$; it depends neither on $H$, nor on $\phi_X$, nor on the $K_x$ (nor on $\chi$).

Locality bound $\lVert\Pi_{\lvert x\rvert\ge L}e^{-iC\lambda}(\phi\otimes\chi)\rVert\le\sum_{n\ge L-R}(\tau\lambda)^n/n!$; the infinite chain is the limit $L\to\infty$ taken first at fixed $\lambda$, $\kappa$ and start.

For each clock level $d_k$: eigenvalues $\pm\omega_k(p)$, $\omega_k=\sqrt{(m+d_k)^2+\tau^2\sin^2p}$, eigenvectors $\lvert p\rangle\otimes\beta_{k,\pm}(p)\otimes\lvert f_k\rangle$ with $\tan\theta_k=-\tau\sin p/(m+d_k)$.
Weak records: $v=\kappa\sigma_X\,w_k(p_0)\,\hat e$ with $w_k(p)=\tau^2\sin p\cos p/\sqrt{\mu_k^2+\tau^2\sin^2p}$, $\mu_k=m+d_k$.
The bound (17.7) of 03-ilang-space/17-motion for this $C_b$ is $v_{\max}=\tau\kappa\sigma_X$, strictly above the largest velocity (5.10).

Moving clock: $q(a;\lambda)=P_N(a;\gamma(p_0)\lambda/\lambda_0)$, i.e. (2.13) with $\lambda\to\gamma(p_0)\lambda$, $\gamma(p_0)=m/\sqrt{m^2+\tau^2\sin^2p_0}$, to first order in $\epsilon=2\pi/(N\lambda_0m)$ and leading order in the spread.
Exact on the chain: $R=[\sqrt{(W+m)^2-w^2}\mp\sqrt{(W-m)^2-w^2}]/(2m)$, $W=\sqrt{m^2+\tau^2}$, $w=\lVert v\rVert/(\kappa\sigma_X)\le W-m$; sign $-$ on the branch through $p_0=0$.
Small $p_0$: $R=1+\lVert v\rVert^2/(2v_{\max}^2)+O(p_0^4)$ with $v_{\max}=\tau\kappa\sigma_X$; in units of $v_{\rm top}=\kappa\sigma_X(W-m)$ the coefficient is $(W-m)/(2(W+m))$.

definitions.name: Plane-wave block of the body contract

open_issues: Curvature of ω_k in d_k gives O(Nε λ/λ0) corrections to (5.14) and O(Nε) relative corrections to the tick; a level-weighted rate is not computed.
Interbranch admixture of the item-3 start (order Nε) adds oscillating velocity terms of order Nε, not computed.
Record effects beyond leading order in κ (drift from ⟨X⟩, decoherence of the view) are out of scope.
(5.10) of 03-ilang-space/05-recording-contract assumes φ_h ≠ 0 for all h; the item-3 start violates this for a ≠ 0, but only u_h and d_0 are used and they do not depend on φ.
The comparison of two carried clocks between two meetings is left to a later package.

consistency_checks.check: Dimensions of ε, γ, R, w/τ (dimensionless) and of v, v_max
p0 = 0 and τ → 0: exact reduction to (2.13), v = 0, R = 1, bound → 0
N = 2: direct two-level computation agrees with (5.14)
